benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: BOBCARD Cashback comes with up to 5% cashback benefits on card spends. It offers accelerated cashback earnings of 4% on online purchases in addition to the base cashback rate of 1%, making it a good option for frequent online shoppers. Though these accelerated 4% savings are limited to Rs. 1,500 for every month , i.e. up to Rs. 37,500 monthly online spends, a low to average spender would still be able to maximise the benefits without much restriction. On the other hand, offline spends come with unlimited 1% cashback. The earned cashback is credited to the account automatically which makes the value-back process simpler for the card user. Read on to know in detail about the features, benefits and fee structure of BOBCARD Cashback.

faqs.q: What is the annual fee of BOBCARD Cashback Credit Card?
faqs.a: BOBCARD Cashback comes with an annual fee of Rs. 499. However, cardholders can also choose the monthly fee plan of Rs. 49 per month.

faqs.q: Can I change the fee plan for BOBCARD Cashback?
faqs.a: Yes, BOBCARD allows you to change the fee plan between annual and monthly fee payments once during the Cashback credit card’s lifecycle.

faqs.q: Why can I not earn 5% cashback on my online spends using BOBCARD Cashback Credit Card?
faqs.a: 5% cashback is offered on select domestic online spends only if you have made at least 4 card transactions in that month. Moreover, this accelerated cashback is also capped at cashback of up to Rs. 1,500 for every month. You will also not earn any cashback on excluded spending categories, as mentioned on this page.

faqs.q: What is the income eligibility criteria for BOBCARD Cashback?
faqs.a: To be eligible for BOBCARD Cashback, the salaried applicant must have a minimum net annual salary of Rs. 3 lakh and a self-employed applicant must have a min. net annual income of Rs. 3.5 lakh.

faqs.q: What is the minimum age requirement for BOBCARD Cashback?
faqs.a: To get BOBCARD Cashback, salaried individuals must be 21 to 60 years old and self-employed must be 24 to 65 years old. However, add-on cardholders can be 18 years and above.

faqs.question: Is the BoB Cashback Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: Yes. The BoB Cashback Credit Card is a good option for users with moderate online spending. It offers 5% cashback on eligible domestic online transactions and 1% cashback on other eligible retail spends, subject to the cashback cap and card terms.

faqs.question: What is the cashback limit on the BoB Cashback Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You can earn a maximum cashback of ₹1,500 per statement cycle. This limit is reached after ₹30,000 of eligible online spending at the 5% cashback rate.

faqs.question: Does the BoB Cashback Credit Card offer 5% cashback on Amazon and Flipkart?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible purchases on Amazon, Flipkart and other domestic online merchants earn 5% cashback, provided the transactions are not part of the excluded merchant categories (MCCs) and you complete at least four retail transactions during the statement cycle.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum spend requirement to earn cashback?
faqs.answer: There is no minimum spend requirement. However, you must complete at least four retail transactions in a statement cycle to receive any cashback for that cycle.

faqs.question: Does the BoB Cashback Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: No. The BoB Cashback Credit Card does not provide complimentary airport lounge access.
